title: It's soft
text: It's soft. The velvety fabric of this cover is really nice...very soft and cushy feeling. It does it's job, covers a bench, and you can remove it for cleaning. What I don't like is the straps used to hold it onto the bench. The ends have little plastic hooks that aren't very secure and are flimsy, and likely to break easily. The straps are constantly coming undone. Very annoying, and only made worse by the fact that they are stark white, so you have little white straps hanging down under your bench. Very unattractive.  Look elsewhere. I don't recommend this.
